user.title: Sign in to AdrenoX
user.description: Unofficial integration, not made or supported by Mahindra. Sign in with the same registered mobile number and password you use in the AdrenoX Connect app.

data_description.mobile: 10-digit Indian mobile number, with or without +91.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to AdrenoX again
reauth_confirm.description: Your AdrenoX session for {mobile} has ended. Polling has stopped until you sign in again.

error.invalid_mobile: That doesn't look like a 10-digit Indian mobile number.
error.invalid_auth: AdrenoX rejected the mobile number or password.
error.rate_limited: AdrenoX asked us to slow down. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach AdrenoX. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This AdrenoX account is already set up.
abort.no_vehicles: This AdrenoX account has no vehicles.
abort.endpoints_not_configured: This version doesn't know the AdrenoX API addresses yet, so it can't sign in. See the README's "Status" section.

data_description.scan_minutes: How often to ask AdrenoX for the car's status. After a failure the interval doubles, up to 2 hours.
data_description.remote_commands: Adds lock/unlock and climate controls where this version supports them. These act on the real car: an automation mistake could unlock it or run the engine. Use at your own risk.
